reviewer: Codex manual sticker artwork and rendered-preview review
method: Compared category contact sheets of transparent PNG artwork, actual 320x180 composited frames, and four timed frames for dynamic variants; checked shape, naming, clipping and category distinctness.

decisions.observation: A wide red rightward arrow stays readable on the pale composite and differs in direction, color and weight from the animated blue arrow.
The blue diagonal arrow clearly points up and right; its angled silhouette differs from the horizontal red arrow and symbol stickers.
A large red X provides a clear reject mark with no confusing overlap with the directional arrows.
The red map pin has a white center and dark outline; its pointed bottom reads as a location marker at preview scale.
A thin turquoise ring with a diagonal handle remains visible on the pale stage and reads as search or inspection.
The short orange horizontal bar is a clear decrease symbol, distinct from the green plus and arrow shapes.
A green upright plus has balanced arms and clear contrast, distinct from the orange minus and red cross.
The blue rightward arrow shifts horizontally across the four sampled moments while staying inside the canvas; it is visibly dynamic unlike the static red arrow.
A narrow orange zigzag reads as energy or speed and has a separate silhouette from flame and warning shapes.
The dark round face and white hands make time readable at preview scale; it differs from the blue crescent and yellow sun.
Two orange flame layers form a pointed upward silhouette, separate from the straight lightning bolt.
The red outlined heart grows and shrinks across sampled frames without clipping; its motion and shape differ from the other atmosphere icons.
A blue crescent moves vertically through sampled moments and remains fully inside the canvas, unlike the static circular clock.
The filled yellow eight-point star is distinct from the yellow sun disk with thin external rays.
A round yellow center with separate fine rays reads as daytime sun and differs from the solid star.
The yellow outlined warning triangle with an exclamation mark changes size across preview frames without leaving the canvas.
A single green check mark clearly conveys completion, separate from the circular dot and shield.
A filled pink disk with dark border reads as a marker point and contrasts with the green check and teal numbered badge.
The purple note has a visible stem and flag, providing a music marker distinct from the gift and callout icons.
A teal circular badge with a readable white numeral one provides a step marker, unlike the plain pink dot.
A solid green shield with dark outline reads as protection and differs from the thin check mark.
A blue rounded callout with a pointed tail reads as dialogue; its shape differs from the angled orange tag.
The orange angled tag has a white eyelet and separate price-label silhouette, unlike the blue dialogue bubble.
The pink ribboned present moves vertically in the sampled preview while remaining fully visible; it is distinct from the flat badge and tag.
